thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Lowered to $185.00 at Robert W. Baird

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Lowered to $185.00 at Robert W. Baird
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price cut by stock analysts at Robert W. Baird from $230.00 to $185.00 in a research report issued to clients and investors on Thursday. The brokerage currently has an “outperform” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Robert W. Baird’s price target points to a potential upside of 29.80% from the company’s previous close.
Several other research firms have also issued reports on AAPL. New Street Research reaffirmed a “sell” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 18th. Needham & Company LLC lifted their price objective on shares of Apple from $220.00 to $260.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Thursday, September 13th. Citigroup reduced their price objective on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a research note on Friday, November 2nd. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $182.00 price objective (down previously from $209.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, November 20th. Three research analysts have sell rating, twenty-six have assigned a hold rating and twenty-one have assigned a buy rating to the stock. Apple has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $197.80.
